Events prints each status event published on the agent bus, one line per
event, until interrupted. Every recorded status report (hooks, "agent report",
approve/deny) publishes one. Needs a running bus.

Events are what was reported, not the resolved status: a change only the
backend's native status shows (e.g. an interrupted permission prompt) has no
event. "agent status" stays the authority.

What it is watching is said once on stderr (-q drops it), so stdout holds
only events.

Usage:
  agent events [name[@host]] [flags]

Examples:
  agent events                 # every agent on this host
  agent events helper
  agent events helper@hub      # an agent on another host
  agent events --all-hosts --json

Flags:
      --all-hosts     Show events from every host
  -h, --help          help for events
      --host string   Host whose events to show (default: this host)
      --json          Print each event as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
